department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences (EECS)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 8:59 pm Pacific; late applications or materials are not accepted.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is December 1, 2026, at 8:59 pm PST.

gre_general.value: EECS neither requires nor accepts GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Please note that Berkeley EECS no longer requires, nor accepts, GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores of any kind are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is no longer required nor accepted.

supervisor.value: You do not need to contact faculty or find an advisor before applying; list faculty of interest on the application.
supervisor.quote: No, you do not need to contact faulty or establish an advisor in order to apply.

funding.value: All incoming PhD and MS/PhD students are offered financial support.
funding.quote: All incoming students to our doctoral programs (MS/PhD and PhD) and some incoming students to our two-year MS program are offered support

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD from a bachelor's (5-6 years) or a master's (3-5 years).
entry_route.quote: Full-time Commitment: 5-6 years (starting with a Bachelor’s), 3-5 years (starting with a Master’s)

notes: One EECS application covers the separate EE and CS PhD degrees; applicants choose PhD or MS/PhD.
name: EECS PhD (Computer Science / Electrical Engineering)
